title: BTW here’s the video I did with the most frightening shows I’ve seen ...
transcript: So which of the two horror plays are you most looking forward to seeing this fall? In the next few months, two horror plays are opening in New York, which is kind of wild because horror on stage has been extremely rare. And even when we do get it, a lot of the time it's more like leaning into the iconography of horror more than it's actually trying to frighten you. Or in the case of Grey House, which I loved, it was a little more heady and thematic, more like an A24 horror movie. But this fall we're getting the New York transfers of Paranormal Activity and 2:00 20 two A Ghost Story. Now, both of these have already played multiple runs, both in the UK and stateside, but I haven't seen either one of them yet, and I'm really curious to see which one ends up being the more thrilling. The sense I get is that 2:22 A Ghost Story is gonna be a little bit more on the schlocky thriller side, whereas Paranormal Activity might provide more genuinely frightening jump scares. I've also heard that neither of them are necessarily the best a writing standpoint, but again, I'm kinda fine with that if they're really leaning into the popcorn entertainment side of horror. But even just the fact that we're getting two supernatural ghost thrillers on stage at the same time is pretty fun. It is really wild that we don't see more of that in theater when You would think the live experience of being in the room really creates a lot of opportunities to scare people in a different way.
showTitle: Upcoming horror plays (Paranormal Activity / 2:22 A Ghost Story)
classificationReason: Anticipation/commentary about two upcoming horror plays (Paranormal Activity and 2:22 A Ghost Story) that the creator has not yet seen; neither appears on the provided list. Grey House is only mentioned briefly in passing.
